LETTRE DE LA CONVERSE : NOTRE COUVERTURE: LETTER FROM LA CONVERSE: OUR COVERAGE OF THE WAR in Palestine-Israel
Dans notre salle de presse, nous essayon: In our newsroom, we try to understand, discuss and reflect on our commitment to rigorous and fair coverage
Les Lettres de La Converse sont écrites: Letters from La Converse are written by our team to our readers, to give you a look behind the scenes of our newsroom.
La guerre qui se déroule en Palestine-Is: The war unfolding in Palestine-Israel is tearing deeply at the human societies that live in this historic territory. Near or far, Palestinian, Israeli, Muslim, Jewish and Christian communities around the world are living with the fallout of a war that seems endless.
La couverture internationale et national: International and national coverage of the Middle East by European and North American media has, at times, done more harm than good. Some Western media narratives have helped dehumanize the people who live in this part of the Middle East, and have also exported their biases into the diaspora.
Nous sommes une équipe diversifiée et co: We are a diverse team, made up of people affected by Islamophobic, antisemitic, racist and discriminatory narratives based on our respective identities. We do not want our work to strip people of their humanity, or to polarize the debate within their communities. In our newsroom, we try to understand, discuss and reflect on our commitment to rigorous and fair coverage of this war, as part of our approach to dialogue journalism. Choosing to make our pen an instrument of dialogue became a natural principle for building bridges. Our newsroom strives to be transparent, accountable and committed to factual truth.
Cela est encore plus important en ces te: This matters even more in times of war, which we do not cover with our eyes closed. Nothing is entirely black or white. La Converse is committed to bringing the necessary nuance to a context of violence that cuts lives short and divides peoples. The reality, however, is that our resources and our access to the ground are limited. But even without a journalist on site, our mission remains the same: La Converse serves marginalized communities, no matter where they are.
Nous prenons tout de même des précaution: We still take precautions so as not to amplify certain narratives that could harm the communities affected by current events. We have a duty to be careful with the words we use, the sources we choose and the information we share.
Si vous voulez être entendu, si votre vo: If you want to be heard, if your voice compels you to speak up, if you would like us to be more attentive to the words we use, or for any other reason, write to us at <l1>info@laconverse.com</l1>. We have always wanted La Converse to be a space of trust, but that also means knowing how to reach out in order to move forward. Not only as individuals with the power to spread information, but also as a media outlet serving marginalized communities.
